one_liner: Cloud CRM with REST/GraphQL APIs and official MCP servers

evidence.claim: Zoho CRM API authenticates via OAuth 2.0 with access/refresh tokens and a client credentials flow
evidence.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.

evidence.claim: Access tokens are passed as Bearer tokens in the Authorization header
evidence.quote: Zoho's OAuth implementation uses Bearer authentication scheme, hence while making API calls, the access token has to be passed in the Authorization header with the prefix Bearer.

evidence.claim: Credentials are self-serve via the Zoho Developer Console
evidence.quote: Go to Zoho Developer Console and click on GET STARTED. ... You will receive the client credentials such as Client ID and Client Secret in the Client Secret tab.

evidence.claim: A free edition and a free Developer Edition exist, with API access included
evidence.quote: APIs Connect Zoho CRM to any app and perform actions with 5000 API calls/day.

evidence.claim: Zoho CRM offers both REST and GraphQL APIs plus official pre-built MCP servers
evidence.quote: Zoho CRM provides these as pre-built MCP servers, so you don't need to build, host, or maintain any infrastructure.

notes: Official MCP: four pre-built servers (Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, Windsurf), OAuth-authenticated; MCP calls consume API credits. GraphQL is gated: 'Available in: Enterprise, Zoho One Enterprise, CRM Plus and Ultimate edition' and not in trial versions. Tokens are organization-specific per environment (Production/Sandbox/Developer) and accounts URLs are datacenter-specific. REST V8 covers many modules (Leads, Contacts, Deals, settings, users, templates), so breadth is broad.
